verdict.rationale: Chronicle's docs say you attach scorers to tasks, and that code-based scorers check concrete outputs or recorded changes, alongside LLM-judge scorers. Scorers return a 0–1 value with configurable pass thresholds and are frozen into versioned suites per run. missing for 10: detailed docs on how to author a code scorer (languages, SDK/API signature, examples), custom aggregate metrics beyond per-check 0–1 scores, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can write custom code-based scorers and metrics for my evaluations

citations.quote: Write a task and attach scorers that check its requirements. Code checks concrete outputs or recorded changes
Scorers return a value from 0 to 1; set pass thresholds to determine whether each required check passed.
Chronicle freezes the suite's current tasks and scorers into a version and pins it to the run
